meta.title: Session Messaging
meta.description: Lets one top-level session message another or open a new one. session_list finds sessions; session_send_message delivers an attributed message that a busy session reads at its next step and an idle or stored session wakes up for; session_create opens a titled session in a workspace and starts it with a message. The recipient sees which session wrote it and can reply the same way. A message carrying a task_id also appends to a task ledger: one writer per task, every wake-up knows what is already done, and session_tasks shows the board. A watchdog retries a round that stops reporting.
